filed: 2026-10-30, after the independent check of the re-gating synthesis (reports/reviews/2026-10-31_review_regating-synthesis-check.md, 'Overclaims') and before any run of amend6.py; never edited after the run
spec: reports/plans/2026-10-30_advice_regating-baseline-FABLE.md, (b)1 and (c), step (d)2; the capitalised-key rule ((b)2) is not run
code: experiments/open_pair/amend6.py (imports amend3.read, amend4.train / over_gate / stop, amend1's helpers); rules open_pair.band_class, carries, score_amend6 (section 'Amendment 6'), edge cases in tests/test_open_pair.py; kv.key_distributions(geometric=True), tested in tests/test_kv.py

settings.keys: Amendment 3's 128 keys (amend3.json keys.keys), 96 trained / 32 held out by open_pair.split_keys (seed 0), checked against amend3.json keys.held
settings.windows: Amendment 3's results/large/amend3/windows_elicit.pt (sha256 against amend3.json maps.elicit.sha256.full); only the table differs, as for Amendment 3's cipher and shuffle
settings.prior: W0's geometric-mean P(token | M key) over every window of that key (kv.key_distributions(geometric=True), fp32 forward)
settings.prior_cipher: kv.bijection (seed 0) over E58's cipher pool (frequency-ranked word-like tokens 1000-2999, as Amendment 3's cipher) minus the 128 keys and the 128 elicit words; a key takes a value only if its prior is in the band and below the key's 100th-largest prior (rank over 100). If the pool runs out, the same draw over every word-like token from rank 1000 (pool used reported); if that runs out, stop
settings.first_letter: letter = the first character of the decoded key, stripped and lower-cased (21 letters among the trained keys; 31 of 32 held-out keys share a letter with a trained key, from the tokenizer before filing); one word per letter by kv.bijection (seed 0) over the same pool, admitted only if its prior is under 1e-5 after every key of that letter; a word starting with its own letter is excluded (review finding 5)
settings.finetune: keydep.finetune, E54's recipe (Adam 3e-5, batch 32, KL 1, clip 1, 300 steps, bf16 autocast), every step 1-30 and 100, 300 kept
settings.reads: label reads from step 10 until G_spec >= G_min (amend4.over_gate, open_pair.pick_cipher_step); then step 30 and that step (amend3.read; r with the route split). First letter: r at a step only if open_pair.carries holds there
settings.order: W0 control; harness control (E58 cipher seed 0 at its gate step 16); prior-matched cipher seeds 0-2; first-letter seeds 0-2
settings.precision: fp32 reads, TF32 off; bf16 fine-tune
settings.saved: no weights (bitwise reproducible on this card: Amendment 4's seed-0 cipher reproduced Amendment 3's r exactly); windows in results/large/amend6
settings.first_letter_null: at every first-letter read: x_null = the held-out keys' specific gain (same pool as x) with each held-out key's target swapped for the word of another trained letter whose trained-key count is nearest its own letter's (ties by a seeded draw, null_seed 0), over G_spec; x, x_null and x - x_null reported
settings.pool_fallback: the pool each map drew from is recorded per map (amend6.json maps.<map>.pool). If the prior-matched cipher fell back to the wider pool, token kind is no longer held to E58's cipher pool, so PM is reported, not scored (score.PM.scored false): its class says nothing about kind at equal prior

thresholds.G_min_source: E58's gate as run (run.json stage0.G_min_spec), as Amendments 1-5
thresholds.high_source: Fable (b)1: 'if r >= 0.6, r tracks the prior'
thresholds.x_entry_source: Fable (c): 0.3, applied since the code review (reports/reviews/2026-10-30_review_e58-amend6-code.md, finding 1) to x - x_null, not x
thresholds.min_entry_source: filed here: a cell needs at least two seeds that carry, so one seed's r cannot fill it
thresholds.noise_source: E58's largest within-map seed range of r at 128 keys, as measured (amend4.json within_key step 30 spread 0.04516)

w0_control: stop unless: the zero update reads exactly 0 on both maps' trained and new tasks; the prior-matched cipher's prior of its trained values (keydep.geo_rate, the saved measure) is in [2e-5, 2e-4]; the first-letter rule's is under 1e-5
harness_control: E58's 128-key cipher seed 0 re-trained and read at step 16 (amend4.json control 0): stop unless r equals amend4.json's 0.32413 within 1e-4

expected.w0_control: zero update 0 exactly; prior-matched cipher prior 3e-5 to 1e-4 (copy 5.9e-5); first-letter prior about 1e-6 (the cipher's 1.4e-6)
expected.prior_cipher: gate step 12-16; x near 0 or negative (no rule to carry, label new); r at 30 between the cipher's 0.29-0.31 and copy's 0.77; the shuffle (prior 1.0e-5) read 0.47-0.48
expected.first_letter: gate step 13-17; x at 30 0-0.3 (most likely), r read only on seeds over 0.3
expected.at_W0: no update: gains 0, x and r undefined (the zero-update check)

PM.what: open_pair.score_amend6 PM: band_class on the prior-matched cipher's r at step 30, seeds 0-2: cipher_band (every r < 0.5) / between / own_guess_band (every r >= 0.6) / unreadable (a seed missing, too small to label, or r not finite)
PM.lean: Fable: cipher_band about 70%. Writer: cipher_band about 40%, between about 35%, own_guess_band about 25% (r rose 0.17 from the cipher to the shuffle over less than one decade of prior; the same slope over the next 0.75 decade reaches about 0.6)
PM.near_cut: reported: true iff some seed's r is within 0.0452 of 0.5
PM.blind_to: one prior level; token kind is held to E58's cipher pool, so a pool effect and a prior effect inside it are not told apart; three seeds; one decomposition

FL.what: open_pair.score_amend6 FL: unreadable if fewer than 2 step-30 reads are labellable (label not too_small / unreadable, x finite); else no_carry if fewer than 2 seeds carry (labellable, x_null finite, x - x_null > 0.3; a tie fails); else band_class on the carrying seeds' r
FL.lean: Writer: no_carry about 70% (at 128 keys the elicit map, whose targets W0 already guesses, carried 0.1-0.2 and rank-1 0.2-0.3); given entry, cipher_band about 50%
FL.blind_to: the granularity limit: own_guess_band cannot tell 'VPD read the rule's existing pieces' from 'r is wrong'; one held-out key's letter is not trained; three seeds; x alone is blind to a frequency-weighted marginal shift (held-out letters are the often-trained ones), which x_null measures

predictions.reported: the same classes at each run's own gate step; each map's W0 prior of its trained and held-out values beside r; E58's five maps' priors and step-30 r (amend3/4/5.json); Spearman of seed-mean r on prior over the seven maps; the prior-matched cipher's x and label are in its reads

branches.stop: a windows mismatch, a W0 control miss, the harness control miss, a pool exhausted, or a block-0 shift: to the lead
branches.PM_cipher_band: r separates the kind of target at equal prior: the prior is not a complete baseline; the synthesis keeps the band claim with this map as its baseline; E45 A2 Job 2 goes ahead as filed, with the prior beside r
branches.PM_own_guess_band: r tracks the prior: the band claim is dead on the 67M and the plain answer becomes 'VPD reads W0's prior'; Job 2 needs the prior as a scored baseline column, refiled, before it is worth $15
branches.PM_between: r sits between the bands at equal prior: the prior explains part of r and kind part; the synthesis says 'r agrees with the prior; whether it reads more is not settled at this resolution'; Job 2 carries the prior column as reported
branches.FL_no_carry: the cell 'a new rule that carries' stays empty on the 67M; first thing to build on Qwen
branches.FL_cipher_band: VPD reads a carrying new rule as new; the line's missing cell is filled
branches.FL_own_guess_band: ambiguous by construction: VPD read the rule's existing pieces (the granularity limit made concrete) or r is wrong; reported as such

amendment_2026_10_30_code_review: Before any run, after the code review of a946868 (reports/reviews/2026-10-30_review_e58-amend6-code.md): FL entry on x - x_null (finding 1); missing or too-small FL seeds read unreadable, not no_carry (2); noise 0.0452 as measured (6); pool recorded per map, PM not scored on a fallback pool (4); a letter's word may not start with that letter (5). Finding 3 (prior admitted on all windows, checked on held-out-row windows) kept: the stop is possible but unlikely and is a stop, not a wrong reading
